history.value: On the dev machine the two-turn product sits where more search depth stops paying on the headline's elites: a rollout leaf is +0.67 HP lost (se 0.31, worse) on all 498 floor-9 elites and three turns -0.75 (se 0.81) on 48, both under the 1.5 HP bar, while the two 'decisive-fight' gains (-1.54 and -2.82) were selection on the outcome (the non-decisive halves lost +2.69 and +1.00); two turns deep the learned leaf carries the edge (+9.3 HP over the heuristic leaf), so what a horizon-complete leaf could add two turns deep is bounded by what a third turn sees.
